    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BlueCoin
    A five-point pickup that activates temporary border wrapping in GameSession.
    Coin
    A collectible with a cached sprite, a free board position and a score value.
    Coin.Sprite
    Cached images for each collectible type.
    CoinSequence
    Chooses coin types for one round when power-ups are enabled.
    CoinSequence.Type
    Collectible types used by the shuffled sequence.
    CoinSound
    Loads and reuses the short coin sound without making gameplay depend on audio.
    Game
    Score, lives and difficulty settings for an endless run.
    GameController
    Connects keyboard/buttons and the animation clock to a testable game session.
    GameController.TurnBuffer
    Queues up to two valid turns while rejecting duplicate and opposite directions.
    GameSession
    Owns one playable run independently of JavaFX stages, input events and rendering.
    GameSession.State
    Lifecycle states used by the controller and view.
    GameView
    Board-first arcade view: one HUD row and a compact start/pause/game-over panel.
    GardenAssets
    Loads each bundled decoration once and creates independently sized views for the UI.
    GoldCoin
    A bonus pickup worth fifteen points.
    HedgeLayouts
    Designs bounded hedge patterns and checks both board connectivity and the current route to food.
    HighScoreStore
    Persists the progressive run personal best; storage failures never interrupt play.
    Launcher
    Ordinary entry point for the packaged application; delegates to the JavaFX application.
    Main
    JavaFX application entry point that creates the single-window view manager.
    Obstacle
    Warned, stationary hedge layouts with safe replacement and temporary two-cell gates.
    PowerUpState
    Independent effect lifetimes measured in successful movement steps, frozen while paused.
    PowerUpState.Effect
    Independent timed effects available during a run.
    RainbowCoin
    A five-point pickup that activates the timed rush effect in GameSession.
    ShrinkCoin
    A mint scissors pickup: awards five points and removes up to three tail segments.
    SilverCoin
    A five-point pickup that requests a temporary hedge gate in GameSession.
    Snake
    Stores snake positions and applies movement, growth and collision rules.
    SnakeBodyPainter
    Maps the original sprite rows onto the moving tail-to-head path in cell units.
    SnakeBodyPainter.Surface
    Drawing callbacks expressed in board-cell units.
    SnakeRenderer
    Draws the original head, patterned body and tapered tail for both gameplay and menu art.
    SnakeSpriteSelector
    Determines body-sprite rotation from neighbouring snake positions.
    SnakeSpriteSelector.Sprite
    Describes whether to use a corner image and its rotation.
    UiIcons
    Small original vector controls; independent of installed icon fonts.
    ViewManager
    Uses one window for the start panel and gameplay, preserving the saved record between runs.
